label: First name
summary: The character's first name.
details: The game names no return type. Vanilla uses it in many texts, often before the house name ('[first name] [house] has gained [title]') or alone ('When [first name] arrives:').

label: First name, base
summary: The base form of the character's first name, as text.
details: Vanilla uses the same name on a character's father and mother in the child naming widget, to offer their name as the child's name. Those lines may concern another type, so this is partly a hint.

label: First name with nickname
summary: The character's first name together with their nickname.
details: The game names no return type. Vanilla uses it once, for the victor of a historic battle on a battle point of interest ('Victor: [name]'). The exact order of name and nickname is not shown.

label: First name with nickname, plain
summary: The first name with nickname, without the hover tooltip.
details: Vanilla uses the same name in event texts, such as '[name] continues to serve you'. Those lines may concern another type, so this is partly a hint.

label: First name, nickname, plain, regnal
summary: The first name with nickname and no tooltip, probably with the regnal number.
details: Going by its name only. The game never uses it.

label: Nicknamed name or me
summary: The first name with nickname, or a word like 'me' when the character is the speaker.
details: Going by its name only. The game never uses it.

label: Nicknamed name or me, plain
summary: The 'or me' form of first name with nickname, without the hover tooltip.
details: Going by its name only. The game never uses it.

label: Nicknamed name/me, plain, regnal
summary: The plain 'or me' form with nickname, probably with the regnal number.
details: Going by its name only. The game never uses it.

label: Nicknamed name/me, regnal
summary: The 'or me' form of first name with nickname, probably with the regnal number.
details: Going by its name only. The game never uses it.

label: First name with nickname, possessive
summary: The first name with nickname in the possessive form, like 'Ada the Wise's'.
details: Vanilla uses the same name in event texts, such as 'I toss [name]'s severed head'. Those lines may concern another type, so this is partly a hint.

label: First name, nickname, possessive, plain
summary: The possessive first name with nickname, without the hover tooltip.
details: Going by its name only. The game never uses it.

label: Nickname, possessive, plain, regnal
summary: The possessive first name with nickname, without tooltip, probably with the regnal number.
details: Going by its name only. The game never uses it.

label: Nickname, possessive/my
summary: The possessive first name with nickname, or a word like 'my' when the character is the speaker.
details: Going by its name only. The game never uses it.

label: Nicknamed possessive or my, plain
summary: The possessive 'or my' form with nickname, without the hover tooltip.
details: Going by its name only. The game never uses it.

label: Nickname, poss./my, plain, regnal
summary: The plain possessive 'or my' form with nickname, probably with the regnal number.
details: Going by its name only. The game never uses it.

label: Nickname, poss./my, regnal
summary: The possessive 'or my' form with nickname, probably with the regnal number.
details: Going by its name only. The game never uses it.

label: First name, nickname, possessive, regnal
summary: The possessive first name with nickname, probably with the regnal number.
details: Going by its name only. The game never uses it.

label: First name, nickname, regnal
summary: The first name with nickname, probably with the regnal number.
details: Going by its name only. The game never uses it.

label: First name, plain
summary: The character's first name, without the hover tooltip.
details: Vanilla uses it in building and figure names, such as 'Temple of [name]', and it is used more than six thousand times in the game's texts. The game does not name its return type.

label: First name, plain, regnal
summary: The first name without tooltip, probably with the regnal number.
details: Vanilla uses the same name in coronation event titles such as 'The Crowning of [host]'. Those lines may concern another type, and that the number is added is a reading of the name.
